## Checklist
- [ ] Layer boundaries respected; no logic in widgets
- [ ] Typed failures, no swallowed exceptions
- [ ] New persisted data has a `BackupContributor` and, if needed, a migration
- [ ] Date logic uses the injected `Clock`
- [ ] No hard-coded styles or strings
- [ ] Tests added or updated
- [ ] No stray comments, dead code or TODOs
- [ ] Docs / ADR / `docs/decisions.md` updated if a decision changed
- [ ] New dependency? One-line reason here:
